title: How to Legally Avoid Paying (most) Taxes
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
I sat down with Brian Bourgerie from Invest Puerto Rico to talk about the island's allure for entrepreneurs. Brian, a seven-year resident, relocated his tech company there attracted by the supportive community, emerging ecosystem, and appealing TAX INCENTIVES.
Puerto Rico distinguishes itself by offering compelling incentives. Invest Puerto Rico, a public-private partnership, is key for attracting new businesses and investments. This episode explores how these elements create a unique environment for various ventures.
